metadata.reproduction: AD retained metrics/trajectories but no state dictionaries; AE reproduces the exact AD adamw fits with AD's trainer and V's source arrays.
metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units. The two readers are analysis-only, fit on V's ordinary-ADD pool (cap 1,500/seed; held-out variant excludes b in {0,5}), tuned on V's canonical VAL (cap 800/seed), evaluated once on V's untouched canonical TEST at the best-on-VAL state. Selection is VAL-only; TEST never selects. Majority-class baselines are derived from the corresponding training labels only. Classical accuracy thresholds are unchanged; interpretation is descriptive and baseline-aware.

primary_decision.rule_note: Descriptive and baseline-aware (categories, not new acceptance thresholds): fit_without_transfer if the reader fits above its training-derived baseline while the held-out-operand accuracy is at/below its variant-matched majority-class baseline or the per-seed gain is positive in fewer than 4/5 seeds; partial_transfer if the held-out accuracy beats its baseline in >=4/5 seeds AND a majority (>10/20) of the held-out operand pairs exceed chance; else inconclusive_mixed. V's V-A/V-B accessibility criterion is retained unchanged and reported separately.

ad_bridge.note: AE reproduces AD's exact adamw fits (same trainer/source/seeds/environment); the bridge should be ~0. Reported, never gating.
